about_short_description.short_description: We are Skills-first hiring solution that help companies automate the soucing and screening process.

product.name: Skill-Based Talent Recruitment
product.description: A platform feature that validates candidates' hard skills, soft skills, and psychometrics to improve hiring accuracy and efficiency.

product.name: Customizable Assessments
product.description: Assessments designed by industry experts to evaluate candidates' true skills and abilities, integrating with hiring systems for a seamless candidate selection process.

product.name: Community Engagement
product.description: A community for recruiters and conversational AI teams to share projects, benchmarks, and best practices, enhancing the creation of digital assistants.

product.name: Talent Marketplace
product.description: A platform connecting individuals with job opportunities, including full-time, freelance, and remote roles, after passing a skills test.

product.name: Skill Improvement Projects
product.description: Offers non-compensated side projects for individuals to learn new skills and improve their portfolios.

product.name: International Hiring Standards Compliance
product.description: Collaboration with companies adhering to international hiring standards to ensure structured career growth experiences for candidates.
